articles.title: Wild Wrap Up Three-Game Road Trip in Florida
Kings at Golden Knights projected lineups

away.summary: The Vegas Golden Knights (4-1-0) are coming off a 4-3 shootout win over Toronto and are projected to dress the same 18 skaters from that game. Carter Hart is expected to start in goal, with Adin Hill as backup. The team will be without Victor Olofsson due to an undisclosed injury, but otherwise have a relatively healthy lineup as they prepare to face Minnesota.

returning: detail expected to return to the lineup and play alongside Jonas Brodin after missing Thursday's game in Tampa Bay.
home.summary: The Minnesota Wild (2-1-1) are concluding a three-game Florida road trip and have been dealing with significant injuries, placing multiple forwards on IR. Defenseman Olli Maatta is expected to return after sitting out Thursday's game, while forward Rieger Lorenz may make his NHL debut. Jesper Wallstedt is projected to start in goal, with Calvin Pickard as backup.
